title: Extensibly Causally Separable Processes Admit Realizations as Quantum Circuits with Classical Control of Causal Order
summary: Indefinite causal order extends the conventional circuit paradigm by allowing local quantum operations to be connected without a predetermined global order. Within the process-matrix framework, it is characterized by causal nonseparability, whereas extensible causal separability (ECS) requires that, under arbitrary input-ancilla extensions, a process admit a recursive decomposition into components, each compatible with a particular operation acting first.
